scope: Installed vanilla Lua/item definitions inspected; offline facades only; native/SP/dedicated NOT TESTED
facts: Base.LargeBranch is the large branch; Base.TreeBranch2 is a separate smaller tree branch. Only Base.LargeBranch is a frame ingredient.

Base.Hammer uses base:hammer; Base.KitchenKnife uses base:sharpknife; vanilla Lua calls item:hasTag(ItemTag.HAMMER) and maps ItemTag.SHARP_KNIFE. Tool variants with those tags qualify if condition is positive.
Base.HandDrill is an existing normal tool with drillwood/drillmetal/drillwoodpoor tags. The recipe requires this exact full type; weaker wood-drilling tools are not substitutes.

Tools must be three distinct actual owned main-inventory objects with positive finite condition. Equipped tools are allowed. No consumption, condition change, new persistence/network schema or research bypass.
